attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "This restructures shared client-side resource dependencies (removing/adding 'depends-on' attributes like 'admin'/'bootstrap' across many core module views) and rewrites TheAdmin.ts/globals.ts module exports consumed by other modules' TypeScript (e.g., autocomplete.ts import path changed), so any theme or module relying on the old 'admin' resource dependency chain or old TheAdmin export paths could silently break script loading order or fail to bundle."

reason: This is a broad refactor of the resource/script-loading pipeline (Bootstrap dependency changes, TheAdmin.ts split, many depends-on attribute changes across modules) touching shared admin UI infrastructure used by every tenant/module, so subtle load-order or missing-dependency regressions could silently break admin pages across the whole framework.
